name: Clementine Esquivel
tagline: voz, palmas, percu y bombo · one half of Dúo Dø デュオ・ドー · Buenos Aires → Japan
bio: Singer, percussionist, composer, producer and educator from Buenos Aires — one half of Dúo Dø (est. 2015), the genre-free, in-motion project weaving Argentine roots with Japan. Her record credit: 'Voz, palmas, percu y bombo.' Led the SongCamp Challenge Latam EP presented on The Creator Economy stage during Devconnect Argentina; artist-in-residence at Kismet Casa during FarCon Rome 2026 (the film 'Mi Amor Por Ti' — Shaka among its Executive Producers); shown with the Infinite Garden Artist Cohort. Japan Tour 2026: Sep 19 – Dec 15.
quote: Cantar en Dúo Dø es como un ritual; es el espacio donde mi voz deja de ser mía para volverse un puente hacia los demás.
